_castCeilings_what: A literal cast to a real type is a fake the compiler has been told not to check. Every one of these types ALREADY has a builder in tests/helpers, so the target for each is ZERO and the number may only fall. Seeded 2026-08-31 from a measurement of 1,735 literal-casts across the test tree; these nine are the ones with a builder standing right next to them.
_logger_closed: CLOSED 2026-09-01. Seeded at 296 hand-rolled logger fakes; the last four were converted the same day (two EDS service suites, one rate-limiting suite whose fake is read inside a jest.mock factory, and one handler testUtils). The list stays as an EMPTY ARRAY rather than being deleted because the two tests below read it: one bans a new hand-rolled fake outright, the other fails on a stale row. With the array empty the first is a flat ban.
_castBans_what: Families that reached ZERO. They live here rather than as a ceiling of 0 because the ceiling test iterates the ceiling KEYS — deleting a key deleted its check, and on 2026-09-01 that left all five silently unenforced for the length of one session. A row here asserts both halves: no casts to the type anywhere outside tests/helpers/, and no ceiling row reopened for it. Entries are never removed.
